title: Alphabet sells bonds worth $20 billion to fund AI spending
title_zh: Alphabet 出售价值 200 亿美元的债券为人工智能支出提供资金
summary: Alphabet has sold bonds worth $20 billion in a ​seven-part offering stretching out to ‌2066, tapping the debt market to fund its ‌surging spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure.
summary_zh: Alphabet 已分七部分发行了价值 200 亿美元的债券，期限持续到 2066 年，利用债务市场为其不断飙升的人工智能基础设施支出提供资金。

title: Why the S&P 500 could hit 7,000 this week
title_zh: 为什么标普 500 指数本周可能触及 7,000 点
summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is approaching 7,000, but progress could depend on a tech-stock (XLK) rally. LPL Financial chief technical strategist Adam Turnquist joins Morning Brief host Julie Hyman to explain what could help push the market higher.
summary_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数 (^GSPC) 接近 7,000 点，但进展可能取决于科技股 (XLK) 的反弹。 LPL Financial 首席技术策略师 Adam Turnquist 与 Morning Brief 主持人 Julie Hyman 一起解释了哪些因素可以帮助推...

title: Apple and Google agree app store changes to appease UK regulator
title_zh: 苹果和谷歌同意改变应用商店以安抚英国监管机构
summary: Apple and Google have agreed to make their mobile app stores fairer and more ​transparent for thousands of developers, Britain's antitrust regulator ‌said on Tuesday, hailing it as important first steps in its tougher regime.
summary_zh: 英国反垄断监管机构周二表示，苹果和谷歌已同意让他们的移动应用商店对数千名开发者来说更​​加公平和透明，并称赞这是其更严格制度中重要的第一步。

title: Memory Chip Squeeze Widens Gap Between Market Winners and Losers
title_zh: 内存芯片挤压扩大了市场赢家和输家之间的差距
summary: Companies from game console maker Nintendo Co. to big PC brands and Apple Inc. suppliers are seeing shares slump on profitability concerns. Memory producers, meanwhile, are soaring to unprecedented heights.
summary_zh: 由于对盈利能力的担忧，从游戏机制造商任天堂公司到大型个人电脑品牌和苹果公司供应商的股价都在下跌。与此同时，内存生产商正在飙升至前所未有的高度。

title: WhatsApp's fight against $268 million Irish privacy fine sent back to lower tribunal
title_zh: WhatsApp 因爱尔兰 2.68 亿美元隐私罚款而被发回下级法庭
summary: BRUSSELS/DUBLIN, Feb 10 (Reuters) - Meta Platforms unit WhatsApp's fight against the EU privacy watchdog was sent back to ​a lower tribunal on Tuesday, prolonging a five-year tussle triggered by the ‌latter's order to the Irish data protection authority to increase a fine to 2...
summary_zh: 布鲁塞尔/都柏林，2 月 10 日（路透社） - Meta Platforms 子公司 WhatsApp 与欧盟隐私监管机构的斗争于周二被发回下级法庭，从而延长了因后者向爱尔兰数据保护机构下令将罚款增加至 2 倍而引发的长达五年的纠纷。

title: Gold falls on investor caution but remains above $5,000 mark
title_zh: 投资者谨慎，金价下跌，但仍维持在 5,000 美元大关上方
summary: Investors are awaiting a string of US economic data
summary_zh: 投资者正在等待一系列美国经济数据

title: Barclays beats profit estimates and unveils plans to return £15bn to investors
title_zh: 巴克莱银行利润超出预期并公布向投资者返还 150 亿英镑的计划
summary: The bank reported profit before tax of £1.9bn in the fourth quarter
summary_zh: 该银行第四季度税前利润为 19 亿英镑

title: 5 questions to ask yourself when considering retirement
title_zh: 考虑退休时要问自己的 5 个问题
summary: When it comes to retiring, you will need to make important decisions on how to take your income. Data shows less than half of people understand their options.
summary_zh: 当谈到退休时，您将需要就如何获取收入做出重要决定。数据显示，只有不到一半的人了解自己的选择。

title: TSMC Revenue Jumps 37% in January as AI Spending Marches On
title_zh: 随着人工智能支出的不断增加，台积电 1 月份收入跃升 37%
summary: The contract chipmaker for Nvidia Corp. reported a 37% rise in January revenue to NT$401.3 billion ($12.7 billion), above the 30% revenue growth TSMC expects for the full year.
summary_zh: 英伟达 (Nvidia Corp.) 的合约芯片制造商报告 1 月份收入增长 37%，达到 4013 亿新台币（127 亿美元），高于台积电预计的全年 30% 收入增长。
